depends_on: central binomial asymptotics C(m, m/2+O(1)) ~ 2^m sqrt(2/(pi m)) in Lean
dominated convergence for the sum over j
notes: M(n) = (1+x)M(n-1) + x sum_{d|n,d<n} M(d) (from floor(n/m) - floor((n-1)/m) = [m|n]), so M(n) = sum_j (1+x)^(n-j) G(j) with G(j) >= 0, deg <= j/2, G(j,1) <= 1.5*3^(j/2); coefficients are mixtures of binomial rows with summable weights g_j 2^-j, so central and maximal coefficient ~ L 2^n sqrt(2/(pi n)), L = lim M(n,1)/2^n. Outside Lean: the whole argument (recurrence checked exactly n <= 400, ratio 1.000075 at n = 400).
